mapper.insert: INSERT INTO point_earn (customer_id, payment_id, amount, remaining, expire_at, status) VALUES (#{customerId}, #{paymentId}, #{amount}, #{remaining}, #{expireAt}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, customer_id, payment_id, amount, remaining, expire_at, status FROM point_earn WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND remaining > 0 AND expire_at >= #{today} ORDER BY expire_at ASC, id ASC
